A host reading arrives already evaluated: the admission bar, the Codex bar, the lane
slots and the free capacity are the placement reader's numbers for that host at read
time. This node chooses among them; it reads no host and holds no host identity.

The dispatch venv's lock hash of the launching host (the request) and of each host
(its reading) arrive the same way (OMN-20862). When they differ and that drift alone
keeps every host from taking the lane, the result is VENV_DRIFT with one reconcile
intent, never a bare no-host.

    NO_HOST = "NO_HOST"
    VENV_DRIFT = "VENV_DRIFT"
    # A hash the drift check needs was not supplied: not a pass, not a drift.
    VENV_UNKNOWN = "VENV_UNKNOWN"
    # An open andon stop in an enforce class refused the engine; the result names the stop and its swarm lane.
    STOPPED = "STOPPED"
    # A host would take the lane but lacks an input the brief needs (a map entry, a clone, a patch
    # or a plan branch), and no host holding every input took it: the send is refused before it is made.
    INPUT_ABSENT = "INPUT_ABSENT"


class ModelRemoteLaneHostReading(BaseModel):
    """One pool host as the placement reader saw it."""

    model_config = _FROZEN

    lane_slots: int = 0
    lane_cap: int = 0

    rank_free: float | None = 0.0

    # The lock hash of this host's dispatch venv. None: the reader did not read it (an old

    dispatch_venv_hash: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1)

    # readings, and whether the tick's host pool alarm still holds ``host-swapping`` open for
    # this host (it resolves after two clean reads, so a host that pages in bursts stays flagged
    # between bursts). None / False: an old producer, which places as before.
    swap_in_kb_s: float | None = None
    mem_psi_avg60: float | None = None
    mem_pressure: int | None = None
    swap_alarm_open: bool = False
    # A collaborator machine (the host table's ``contributor: true``). It takes a lane only bound to
    # its own collaborator lane, never to a lane the non-contributor hosts bind, and only while that
    # lane can take a lane. False: an ordinary pool host, judged as before.
    contributor: bool = False
    # The lane a lane on this host is bound to (the host table's ``lane_binding``, else its
    # ``ledger_bus_lane``). None: the row declares none, so a contributor host takes no lane.

# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 OmniNode.ai Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Which pool host takes one remote lane (OMN-20669).

A port of the remote-lane runner's ``eligible``, ``choose_codex`` and the shared
``choose_lane`` over readings the placement reader already evaluated:

- A Claude-engine lane never lands on a host with a live usage-limit or auth-expired
  mark, nor on one the lane admission bar refuses, and only on the pinned host when
  one is pinned. Of the hosts holding a login for the engine with a lane slot, the
  lab hosts come first and the launching host only when no lab host has a slot; the
  pick is the best spread key (an idle host, then the lowest fill, then free capacity,
  memory, the launching host, the name).
- A Codex lane holds no Claude login, so no Claude mark keeps it off a host. A
  Codex-specific usage mark does keep it off that host. It takes
  the admitted host the Codex bar passes with the most free capacity, then memory,
  then the name.

Collaborator machines (OMN-21599, operator RULING 2026-10-30T16:45:31Z): a host whose reading is a
``contributor`` takes a lane only bound to the lane its own row declares, never to a lane the
non-contributor hosts bind, and only while that lane can take a lane (``lane_ready``). Otherwise its
verdict names the reason and the host takes no lane; it is never given a house-lane one.

Dispatch-venv drift (OMN-20862): when the launching host's dispatch-venv lock hash and
a host's differ, the host takes no lane. A lane that finds no host only because of that
is answered VENV_DRIFT, naming both hashes with one reconcile intent for the drifted
hosts, never a bare no-host. Drift counts only on a host that would otherwise take the
lane (a usage mark, the admission bar, the pin or a full host is a different reason). A
hash that was not supplied on a drift-judged request is VENV_UNKNOWN, never a pass. A
request carrying no hash and not marked ``dispatch_venv_required`` is an old producer's
and places as before.

OMN-21396: supplied ladder facts choose the cheapest eligible engine up to the route
ceiling, escalating past failed attempts and returning one experiment row for the last.
A lane declaring a capability the Codex sandbox cannot grant skips the Codex rung.
RULING 2026-10-28T13:32:09Z makes Sonnet the default and admits Opus only with an
escalation_reason (complexity:<B4 or above> or sonnet-failed:<run or lane>), for legacy
requests and pinned routes alike; a failed Sonnet attempt is itself that reason.

Paging hosts (OMN-17232): a host the throughput tick's host-swapping check flags (the same
``swap_reasons`` the host pool alarm applies to the probe's swap-in, memory PSI and macOS pressure
readings) has zero free lane slots, for either engine, until the alarm resolves it after two clean
reads (``swap_alarm_open``). At 2026-10-30T01:25Z a lab host paged at load 30 to 58 and swap-in up to
167 MB/s while the pool counted it 6 to 9 free Claude slots, so ``--placement auto`` never overflowed
to a cloud session.

Brief inputs (OMN-19998): a lane whose brief needs inputs on its host (a map entry, a clone, a
patch or a plan branch, ``required_inputs``) takes only a host whose reading holds every one
(``present_inputs``); a reading that did not check them keeps the host off. When a host would take
the lane but for its inputs and none holding them does, the result is INPUT_ABSENT naming each
absent input, so the dispatch refuses the send instead of starting a lane that cannot find its input.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from omnibase_core.models.contracts.subcontracts.model_fsm_subcontract import (
    ModelFSMSubcontract,
)

from omnimarket.handlers.handler_engine_ladder import load_engine_ladder
from omnimarket.handlers.rules_stop_gate import (
    engine_stop_scopes,
    gate_dispatch,
    load_andon_stop_contract,
)
from omnimarket.models.model_engine_experiment import (
    CLAUDE_RUNGS,
    CODEX_UNGRANTABLE_CAPABILITIES,
    ESCALATING_OUTCOMES,
    LOW_RISK_CLASSES,
    NO_ENGINE,
    QUOTA_FREE_RUNGS,
    RUNG_GATES,
    ModelEngineExperimentRow,
)

from omnimarket.models.model_host_pool_reading import ModelHostPoolReading
from omnimarket.models.remote_lane_placement import (
    CODEX_ENGINE,
    EnumRemoteLaneOutcome,
    ModelRemoteLaneHostReading,
    ModelRemoteLaneHostVenv,
    ModelRemoteLaneHostVerdict,

from omnimarket.models.stop_gate import EnumStopGateOutcome
from omnimarket.nodes.node_host_pool_alarm_effect.handler import swap_reasons
from omnimarket.nodes.node_lane_model_policy_compute.handlers.handler_lane_model_policy import (
    lane_model_refusal,
)

_VENV_DRIFT = "venv-drift"
_VENV_UNKNOWN = "venv-unknown"


def swap_refusal(reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading) -> str | None:
    """Why the tick's host-swapping check keeps this host off, else None.

    The reasons are the host pool alarm's own (``swap_reasons`` over its bounds); an alarm still open
    for the host keeps it off between bursts until two clean reads resolve it.
    """
    reasons = swap_reasons(
        ModelHostPoolReading(
            host=reading.name,
            lane_cap=reading.lane_cap,
            error=None,
            swap_in_kb_s=reading.swap_in_kb_s,
            mem_psi_avg60=reading.mem_psi_avg60,
            mem_pressure=reading.mem_pressure,
        )
    )
    if reasons:
        return f"host-swapping: {'; '.join(reasons)}"
    if reading.swap_alarm_open:
        return "host-swapping: alarm open until two clean reads"
    return None


def contributor_lane_refusal(
    request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest, reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading
) -> str | None:
    """Why a collaborator machine takes no lane here, else None (a host that is not one is never judged).

    Operator RULING 2026-10-30T16:45:31Z: work may run on a collaborator's machine, but never in the
    lane the house works in and breaks; the collaborators have a lane of their own. So a contributor
    host takes a lane only bound to the lane its row declares, that lane must not be one the
    non-contributor hosts bind, and it must be able to take a lane. Every name is the host table's:
    no host and no lane is written here.
    """
    if not reading.contributor:
        return None
    bound = reading.bus_lane
    if bound is None:
        return "contributor-host: its row declares no lane to bind, so it takes no lane"
    house = {r.bus_lane for r in request.readings if not r.contributor and r.bus_lane}
    if bound in house:
        return (
            f"contributor-host: its row binds {bound}, the lane the house hosts bind; "
            f"a collaborator machine takes no {bound}-lane work"
        )
    asked = request.lane or bound
    if asked != bound:
        return (
            f"contributor-host: a {asked}-bound lane is refused; "
            f"its lanes bind {bound} only"
        )
    if not reading.lane_ready:
        return (
            f"contributor-host: its lane {bound} cannot take a lane yet: "
            f"{reading.lane_not_ready_reason or 'no reason declared'}"
        )
    return None


def input_refusal(
    request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest, reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading
) -> str | None:
    """Why this host lacks an input the lane's brief needs, else None (a lane needing none is never judged)."""
    if not request.required_inputs:
        return None
    if reading.present_inputs is None:
        return "input-unread: the reader did not check " + ", ".join(
            request.required_inputs
        )
    present = set(reading.present_inputs)
    absent = [item for item in request.required_inputs if item not in present]
    if absent:
        return "input-absent: " + ", ".join(absent)
    return None


def repair_pin_line(
    request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest,
    pick: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading | None,
) -> str | None:
    """The line that says a repair lane pinned to its own target was not kept there (OMN-23389).

    On 2026-11-09 the first cleanup lane for h053 was pinned to h053, which refused admission with a full disk, so
    the repair never ran. A repair lane is never run on the host it repairs; the pin names the target.
    """
    target = request.repair_target
    if target is None or request.pinned_host != target or pick is None:
        return None
    refused = next(
        (
            r.lane_admission_refusal
            for r in request.readings
            if r.name == target and r.lane_admission_refusal is not None
        ),
        None,
    )
    why = (
        f"it refuses admission ({refused})"
        if refused
        else "a repair lane never runs on the host it repairs"
    )
    return (
        f"REPAIR-PIN-REFUSED pinned to {target}: {why}; placed on {pick.name}, "
        f"which reaches {target} over ssh"
    )


def effective_lane_slots(reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading) -> int:
    """The free lane slots the pool counts for this host: none while the host is swapping."""
    return 0 if swap_refusal(reading) is not None else reading.lane_slots


def pool_lane_slots(readings: tuple[ModelRemoteLaneHostReading, ...]) -> dict[str, int]:
    """Every host's free lane slots as the pool counts them."""
    return {reading.name: effective_lane_slots(reading) for reading in readings}


def _rank(reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading) -> float:
    return float("-inf") if reading.rank_free is None else reading.rank_free


def _spread_key(
    reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading,
) -> tuple[bool, float, float, float, bool, str]:
    cap = reading.lane_cap
    fill = 1.0 if cap <= 0 else min(1.0, reading.placed / cap)
    return (
        reading.placed == 0,
        -fill,
        _rank(reading),
        reading.mem_avail_gb,
        reading.local,
        reading.name,
    )


def _codex_key(reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading) -> tuple[float, float, str]:
    return (_rank(reading), reading.mem_avail_gb, reading.name)


def _drift_judged(request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest) -> bool:
    return (
        request.dispatch_venv_required
        or request.launching_venv_hash is not None
        or any(r.dispatch_venv_hash is not None for r in request.readings)
    )


def _venv_reason(
    request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest, reading: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading
) -> str | None:
    """The reason the venv keeps this host off, else None (equal hashes)."""
    if request.launching_venv_hash is None or reading.dispatch_venv_hash is None:
        return _VENV_UNKNOWN
    if reading.dispatch_venv_hash != request.launching_venv_hash:
        return _VENV_DRIFT
    return None


def _select(
    request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest,
    blocked: dict[str, str],
    check_inputs: bool = True,
) -> tuple[ModelRemoteLaneHostReading | None, dict[str, str]]:
    """The pick and every host's reason for not being it, with ``blocked`` hosts kept off.

    ``check_inputs`` False judges the hosts as if the brief needed no input, to tell INPUT_ABSENT from NO_HOST.
    """
    codex = request.engine == CODEX_ENGINE
    limited = set(request.codex_limited_hosts if codex else request.limited_hosts)
    expired = set() if codex else set(request.auth_expired_hosts)
    reasons: dict[str, str] = {}
    admitted: list[ModelRemoteLaneHostReading] = []
    target = request.repair_target
    for reading in request.readings:
        if target is not None and reading.name == target:
            reasons[reading.name] = (
                "repair-target: a repair lane runs on another host and reaches this one over ssh"
            )
        elif reading.name in limited:
            reasons[reading.name] = "usage-limited"
        elif reading.name in expired:
            reasons[reading.name] = "auth-expired"
        elif reading.name in blocked:
            reasons[reading.name] = blocked[reading.name]
        elif (collaborator := contributor_lane_refusal(request, reading)) is not None:
            reasons[reading.name] = collaborator
        elif (swapping := swap_refusal(reading)) is not None:
            reasons[reading.name] = swapping
        elif reading.lane_admission_refusal is not None:
            reasons[reading.name] = f"admission: {reading.lane_admission_refusal}"
        elif (
            request.pinned_host
            and request.pinned_host != target
            and reading.name != request.pinned_host
        ):
            reasons[reading.name] = "not-pinned"
        elif target is not None and (
            reading.ssh_reach is None or target not in reading.ssh_reach
        ):
            reasons[reading.name] = f"no-ssh-to-{target}"
        elif check_inputs and (absent := input_refusal(request, reading)) is not None:
            reasons[reading.name] = absent
        else:
            admitted.append(reading)

    pick: ModelRemoteLaneHostReading | None = None
    if codex:
        fit = []
        for reading in admitted:
            if reading.codex_refusal is None:
                fit.append(reading)
            else:
                reasons[reading.name] = f"codex: {reading.codex_refusal}"
        if fit:
            pick = max(fit, key=_codex_key)
    else:
        held = []
        for reading in admitted:
            if request.engine in reading.engines:
                held.append(reading)
            else:
                reasons[reading.name] = f"no-{request.engine}-login"
        for tier in (
            [r for r in held if not r.local],
            [r for r in held if r.local],
        ):
            fit = []
            for reading in tier:
                if reading.lane_slots > 0:
                    fit.append(reading)
                else:
                    reasons[reading.name] = "no-lane-slot"
            if fit:
                pick = max(fit, key=_spread_key)
                break
        if pick is not None and not pick.local:
            for reading in held:
                if reading.local and reading.name not in reasons:
                    reasons[reading.name] = "lab-host-first"
    return pick, reasons


def _escalation_reason(ladder: ModelRemoteLaneLadder) -> str | None:
    """The declared reason, else the lane's own failed Sonnet attempt."""
    if ladder.escalation_reason:
        return ladder.escalation_reason
    if any(
        a.engine == "sonnet" and a.outcome in ESCALATING_OUTCOMES
        for a in ladder.attempts
    ):
        return f"sonnet-failed:{ladder.lane}"
    return None


def _rung_reason(
    engines: ModelEngineLadder, ladder: ModelRemoteLaneLadder, rung: str
) -> str | None:
    """The first route or readiness rule that refuses a rung."""
    if engines.index(rung) > engines.index(ladder.ceiling):
        return "above-route-ceiling"
    if refusal := lane_model_refusal(
        rung, escalation_reason=_escalation_reason(ladder)
    ):
        return refusal
    if ladder.pinned and rung != ladder.ceiling:
        return "pinned-to-route"
    if ladder.claude_required and rung not in CLAUDE_RUNGS:
        return "claude-required"
    failing = {
        "landing-worker": ladder.landing_worker,
        # A lane that declares no risk class is judged by its kind (a small-fix lane).
        "risk-class": (ladder.risk_class or ladder.lane_kind) not in LOW_RISK_CLASSES,
        "no-writable-or-check": not ladder.code_edit_ready,
        "no-local-slot": ladder.local_model_slots == 0,
        "sandbox-capability": bool(
            set(ladder.required_capabilities) & set(CODEX_UNGRANTABLE_CAPABILITIES)
        ),
    }
    return next((gate for gate in RUNG_GATES[rung] if failing[gate]), None)


def _experiment(
    ladder: ModelRemoteLaneLadder, rung: str | None
) -> ModelEngineExperimentRow | None:
    """Describe the last finished attempt and the placement's next engine."""
    if not ladder.attempts:
        return None
    last = ladder.attempts[-1]
    return ModelEngineExperimentRow(
        lane=ladder.lane,
        ticket=ladder.ticket,
        attempt=len(ladder.attempts),
        engine=last.engine,
        model=last.model,
        outcome=last.outcome,
        failure_cause=last.failure_cause,
        duration_s=last.duration_s,
        next_engine=rung or NO_ENGINE,
    )


class HandlerRemoteLanePlacement:
    """Choose the host for one remote lane from the pool's evaluated readings.

    The engine ladder is the ``config.engine_ladder`` of this node's contract, read once at
    composition (OMN-21475); a caller may inject a validated ladder.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        engines: ModelEngineLadder | None = None,
        stop_fsm: ModelFSMSubcontract | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self._engines = load_engine_ladder() if engines is None else engines
        self._stop_fsm = stop_fsm

    def handle(
        self, request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest
    ) -> ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult:
        ladder = request.ladder
        if ladder is None:
            return self._place(request)
        last_result = ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult(host=None, engine=request.engine)
        start = 0
        if ladder.attempts:
            last = ladder.attempts[-1]
            if last.outcome not in ESCALATING_OUTCOMES:
                return last_result.model_copy(
                    update={"experiment": _experiment(ladder, None)}
                )
            start = self._engines.index(last.engine) + 1
        rungs: list[ModelRemoteLaneRungVerdict] = []
        for rung in self._engines.rungs[start:]:
            reason = _rung_reason(self._engines, ladder, rung)
            if reason is not None:
                rungs.append(ModelRemoteLaneRungVerdict(engine=rung, reason=reason))
                continue
            placement_request = request.model_copy(
                update={
                    "engine": self._engines.host_engine(rung),
                    "ladder": None,
                    "escalation_reason": _escalation_reason(ladder),
                    **(
                        {"limited_hosts": (), "auth_expired_hosts": ()}
                        if rung in QUOTA_FREE_RUNGS
                        else {}
                    ),
                }
            )
            result = self._place(placement_request)
            if result.outcome == EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.ADMITTED:
                rungs.append(ModelRemoteLaneRungVerdict(engine=rung, reason="chosen"))
                return result.model_copy(
                    update={
                        "rung": rung,
                        "engine": self._engines.host_engine(rung),
                        "rungs": tuple(rungs),
                        "experiment": _experiment(ladder, rung),
                    }
                )
            rungs.append(
                ModelRemoteLaneRungVerdict(
                    engine=rung,
                    reason=(
                        f"stopped: {result.refusal}"
                        if result.outcome == EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.STOPPED
                        else f"no-capacity: {result.outcome.value}"
                    ),
                )
            )
            last_result = result
        return last_result.model_copy(
            update={
                "host": None,
                "rung": None,
                "engine": request.engine,
                "rungs": tuple(rungs),
                "experiment": _experiment(ladder, None),
            }
        )

    def _place(
        self, request: ModelRemoteLanePlacementRequest
    ) -> ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult:
        if refusal := lane_model_refusal(
            request.engine, escalation_reason=request.escalation_reason
        ):
            return ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult(
                host=None,
                engine=request.engine,
                verdicts=tuple(
                    ModelRemoteLaneHostVerdict(host=reading.name, reason=refusal)
                    for reading in request.readings
                ),
            )
        gate = None
        if request.stop_gate is not None:
            if self._stop_fsm is None:
                self._stop_fsm = load_andon_stop_contract()[0]
            gate = gate_dispatch(
                request.stop_gate,
                engine_stop_scopes(request.engine, self._engines),
                self._stop_fsm,
            )
            if gate.outcome is EnumStopGateOutcome.REFUSE:
                return ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult(
                    host=None,
                    engine=request.engine,
                    verdicts=tuple(
                        ModelRemoteLaneHostVerdict(host=r.name, reason=gate.line)
                        for r in request.readings
                    ),
                    outcome=EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.STOPPED,
                    refusal=gate.line,
                    stop_gate=gate,
                )
        pick, reasons = _select(request, {})
        blocked: dict[str, str] = {}
        if _drift_judged(request):
            # Only a host that would take the lane absent the venv can be blamed on it.
            for reading in request.readings:
                if reasons.get(reading.name, "ranked-lower") in (
                    "ranked-lower",
                    "lab-host-first",
                ):
                    reason = _venv_reason(request, reading)
                    if reason is not None:
                        blocked[reading.name] = reason
        venv_drift: ModelRemoteLaneVenvDrift | None = None
        reconcile: ModelRemoteLaneReconcileIntent | None = None
        outcome = EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.NO_HOST
        if blocked:
            unblocked_pick, reasons = _select(request, blocked)
            if unblocked_pick is not None:
                pick = unblocked_pick
            else:
                held_off = [r for r in request.readings if r.name in blocked]
                venv_drift = ModelRemoteLaneVenvDrift(
                    launching_hash=request.launching_venv_hash,
                    hosts=tuple(
                        ModelRemoteLaneHostVenv(host=r.name, hash=r.dispatch_venv_hash)
                        for r in held_off
                    ),
                )
                drifted = tuple(
                    r.name for r in held_off if blocked[r.name] == _VENV_DRIFT
                )
                if drifted:
                    outcome = EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.VENV_DRIFT
                    reconcile = ModelRemoteLaneReconcileIntent(
                        hosts=drifted, target_hash=request.launching_venv_hash
                    )
                else:
                    outcome = EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.VENV_UNKNOWN
                pick = None
        input_line: str | None = None
        if pick is not None:
            outcome = EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.ADMITTED
        elif outcome is EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.NO_HOST and request.required_inputs:
            # The send is refused before it is made: a host would take the lane but for its inputs.
            would_take, _ = _select(request, blocked, check_inputs=False)
            if would_take is not None:
                outcome = EnumRemoteLaneOutcome.INPUT_ABSENT
                input_line = (
                    f"{would_take.name} {reasons.get(would_take.name, 'input-absent')}"
                )

        verdicts = []
        for reading in request.readings:
            if pick is not None and reading.name == pick.name:
                reason = "chosen"
            else:
                reason = reasons.get(reading.name, "ranked-lower")
            verdicts.append(
                ModelRemoteLaneHostVerdict(host=reading.name, reason=reason)
            )
        return ModelRemoteLanePlacementResult(
            host=pick.name if pick is not None else None,
            engine=request.engine,
            local=pick.local if pick is not None else False,
            verdicts=tuple(verdicts),
            outcome=outcome,
            venv_drift=venv_drift,
            reconcile=reconcile,
            refusal=input_line,
            stop_gate=gate,
            repair_pin_refused=repair_pin_line(request, pick),
        )
